 Mumbai, Nov 7 (PTI) A fire broke out in a 32-storey residential building in Mumbai’s Andheri West on Saturday night, though there is no report of anyone getting injured in the incident, an official said.
 The fire brigade received a call about a blaze on the 15th floor of Runwal Tower in Lokhandwala area at 9:50 pm, following which four fire engines and other equipment were deployed to douse it, he said.
 “Firefighting operations are underway at the site. There is no report of injuries to anyone as of now,” the official added. PTI KK BNM
